name: Project switcher
author: Brett
description: Separate workspaces: each project has its own builds, notes, to-dos, tasks, lists and plans, and a new one starts empty. AmberX AXF holds everything from before projects. Banner chip shows the active project; tap it, the app menu (Builds → Project), the right-click menu or Settings → Plugins → Projects to switch, start a new project, rename, archive or delete one (archive and delete ask you to type its id; the data stays on disk). Each project shares Claude accounts, credentials, plugins, console settings and the axHub connection until you give it its own copy of any of them (Settings → Plugins → Projects). Projects are framework data (framework/cli/projects.mjs, projects@1): removing this plugin leaves them and their data in place.

items.title: List projects
items.description: Every project with its build counts and which one is active (voice: 'what projects do I have').

items.title: Active project
items.description: The project the console, AmberX and every build list work on now (voice: 'which project am I in').

items.title: New project
items.description: Start a new, empty project with its own builds, notes, to-dos, tasks, lists and plans, and switch to it (voice: 'new project called Garden'). select false keeps the current one active.

id.description: optional id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes (default: from the name)

items.title: Switch project
items.description: Make another project the active one, for every device and session (voice: 'switch to project AmberX AXF'). Running builds of other projects keep running.

items.title: Rename a project
items.description: Change a project's name or description (voice: 'rename project garden to Garden Planner').

items.title: Archive a project
items.description: Take a project off the switcher; its data stays and its queued builds stop being dispatched. confirm must be the project id (tell Brett first). AmberX AXF can't be archived.

confirm.description: the project id, typed to confirm

items.title: Unarchive a project
items.description: Put an archived project back on the switcher (voice: 'bring back project garden').

items.title: Delete a project
items.description: Take a project off the list for good; its data folders stay on disk (create a project with the same id to get it back). confirm must be the project id (tell Brett first). AmberX AXF can't be deleted.

confirm.description: the project id, typed to confirm

items.title: What a project owns
items.description: Which of Claude accounts, credentials, plugins, console settings and the axHub connection a project keeps as its own (the rest it shares with every project), its own Claude account set, and where each lives (voice: 'what does this project own'). project defaults to the active one.

items.title: Give a project its own copy
items.description: Make a project keep its own copy of one scope, copied from the shared set (or from another project with from) so nothing goes blank (voice: 'give this project its own credentials'). AmberX AXF is the shared set and can't own.

scope.description: what to own or share: claude-accounts, credentials, plugins (and their settings), console (settings and look) or hub (axHub connection)

from.description: 'shared' (default) or a project id to copy from

reseed.description: copy again over an own copy it already has

items.title: Share a scope again
items.description: A project goes back to the shared copy of one scope; its own copy stays on disk (voice: 'share Claude accounts again'). Tell Brett first: the project's own values stop being used.

scope.description: what to own or share: claude-accounts, credentials, plugins (and their settings), console (settings and look) or hub (axHub connection)

items.title: Edit a project's Claude accounts
items.description: For a project that owns its Claude accounts: add or remove saved logins from its set and pick its active one (voice: 'add mossesx-max to this project's accounts'). Logins stay saved once for every project.
